messages:
maria: Hey team — partner (BridgeLayer) just surfaced a blocker for the joint POC. Customer requires the Bridge adapter deployed in our Private flow, but they need a signed reseller PSC and a signed DPA before we can spin up their staging tenant. Can someone from sales/legal weigh in?
aj: ack. can you paste the exact clause they're asking for from the partner SOW?
partner_eng: they want a PSC that explicitly allows partner billing and preserves tenant isolation. exact quote: 'reseller shall be permitted to invoice usage under partner SKU while tenant data remains under customer-controlled VPC.'
sean: that's unusual but doable. question: do we need any infra changes to support partner-billed tenants?
olivia: from infra side — we need entitlement mapping + a billing tag pass-through. Private control plane already supports tenant metadata, but partner token exchange flow needs a callback endpoint.
maria: partner wants it asap for next-week demo. also asked about security questionnaire items: VPN, HSM/KMS usage, egress controls, and audit log retention.
legal_ops: short answer: we can do DPA + PSC redlines but need to confirm indemnity and data residency bits. send over their standard PSC and we'll mark change-buckets.
aj: pricing question from them — pilot discount for 3 months with usage cap, and then commit to Dedicated if metrics look good. who owns the pricing numbers?
sean: I'll run a quick unit-econ for expected pilot load. need estimated qps + token mix. partner_eng can you share expected workload?
partner_eng: rough numbers: 15 rps peak, mostly chat completion with ~400 tokens/request. occasional embeddings at low volume. 1TB egress/month estimate.
olivia: for 15 rps on Private with latency SLO 300ms, recommend a 2-GPU staging pool (A100s) with auto-burst. KV cache will help. we can cap autoscale to control cost.
maria: can we provide a short-run runbook and a sample config to hand to their infra? that usually smooths provisioning.
sean: yes — sample config below (simple):
```
# tenant config snippet
tenant_id: bridge-demo-01
billing: partner_bridge_sku
quota:
  tokens_per_month: 25000000
  burst_qps: 30
network:
  vpc_peering: required
  egress_restrictions:
    allowed_ips: [10.2.0.0/16]
kms: customer-managed
```
partner_eng: perfect. also they flagged that our default audit retention (30d) is too short — they need 1 year for compliance. is that configurable per tenant?
olivia: yes, retention is configurable on Private; we need to add a note about storage sizing.
legal_ops: they'll also want an SOC2 attestation and a clause for right-to-audit when on Dedicated later. we can reference our compliance pack; need partner contact for paperwork.
amelia: @maria heads-up — partner asked whether HSM integration is supported for on-prem KMS/HSM handshake.
maria: tagging @legal_ops and @olivia. partner contact is megan@bridgelayer.com.
aj: next steps I suggest: 1) maria to get PSC & DPA from partner; 2) legal_ops to propose redlines within 48h; 3) infra to prepare staging tenant runbook + sample config; 4) sean to send pilot cost estimate; 5) partner_eng to confirm workload by EOD.
partner_eng: confirmed, we'll get workload spreadsheet by EOD.
legal_ops: will start redlines. quick Q: does Bridge require IP allowlist or do they want a managed peering?
partner_eng: prefer peering, but can do allowlist for demo.
maria: OK — I'll coordinate and update the customer. thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: staging tenant provisioning queued (ticket #6421). will confirm when infra has env ready.
